notBlocking.summary: scriptEnd() treats a vertical tab after `<script` or `</script` as a tag-name end (PCRE \s includes \x0B; HTML5’s list is tab, LF, FF, space, / and >). In an escaped script this can enter the double-escaped state where browsers do not, so text after the script is left unconverted. Under-editing only, never a script edit.

notBlocking.acceptance: Use [\t\n\f\r /> ] in the script-state patterns; a corpus case with \x0B.
notBlocking.cause: PCRE \s is wider than HTML whitespace.
